name: David B. Summer
tagline: Top rated Tax attorney in Boston, Massachusetts

firm.name: Law Office of David B. Summer

about: David B. Summer is an attorney at the Law Office of David B. Summer, which has its offices in Boston, Massachusetts. With over 26 years of experience practicing law, he takes on cases involving employment law matters, wage and hour matters, tax law, real estate matters and business law.

Mr. Summer has a reputation for his hardworking and persistent nature while taking on any case. He is a compassionate and understanding attorney who keeps his clients informed through every stage in their legal process. He knows how an employment law matter can affect an individual, and he fights for their rights and liberties.

Serving clients throughout the Boston metro area, Mr. Summer is licensed to practice in Massachusetts and New York and before the Tax Court. He counsels clients in regard to tax law matters and represents them before the Internal Revenue Service in audits. He also helps businesses as well as individuals to prepare tax returns. In addition, he handles real estate closings.

Graduating with dean’s list honors, Mr. Summer has a Bachelor of Science degree in speech communication and political science from Syracuse University. He was the recipient of the Intercollegiate Athletic Academic Achievement Award and was a member of the Cornell University Debate Tournament.

Mr. Summer went on to pursue his legal studies at the Boston University School of Law, where he obtained his Juris Doctor in 1996. In law school, he was a member of the American Journal of Law & Medicine, where he also had some of his articles published. He was a member of the Moot Court team as well.

From the Boston University School of Law, Mr. Summer graduated in the top 25% of his class with a Master of Law degree in taxation in 2001. He uses his extensive experience and skill for the benefit of his clients with a firm commitment to their needs.
